newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Feed buys 50,000T of Canadian feed barley.
newsitem.headline: Korea Feed buys 50,000T of Canadian feed barley.

text.p: The Korea Feed Association (KFA) on Tuesday bought 50,000 tonnes of Canadian feed barley at $141 per tonne, C&F, traders said.
Traders said Mitsubishi Corp of Japan won the contract with delivery on December 5 to the western port city of Inchon.

The KFA had initially invited tenders for 35,000 tonnes of corn and 15,000 tonnes of feed barley. But it decided to buy additional 35,000 tonnes of feed barley as the price was more attractive than corn, they said.
